entries.text: Fixed QuestDB rejecting a scalar subquery in the select list of an ungrouped aggregate ('query is not expected, did you mean column?'), which failed the TPC-DI VQ4, EQ3 and EQ4 validation queries; the aggregates are staged in a derived table and each uncorrelated one-row subquery is cross-joined to it as its own derived table, keeping the original output column names.
